console.title: Meta credit and keys
console.subtitle: Connect your Meta business, then share your credit line with customers so Meta bills you and you bill them.
console.optionalBody: You need Solution Partner status and an approved credit line with Meta. Everything else (wallets, prices, plans) works without it.
console.readOnly: You can look at this page, but only super admins can change it.

step1.title: 1. Connect your Meta business
step1.tokenStored: Stored. Leave blank to keep it.
step1.tokenHint: Needs business_management, whatsapp_business_management and whatsapp_business_messaging. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
step1.creditLineHint: Optional. Blank means the first credit line of your business is found and remembered.
step1.graphVersionHint: Looks like v26.0. Blank uses v26.0.
step1.ratesEndpointHint: Optional https address that returns Meta's price list. Blank uses the bundled rate card or an uploaded file.
step1.baseCurrencyHint: The currency of the income figures. Three letters, for example USD.
step1.autoAttachHint: A reseller workspace that connects a number gets your credit line without anyone pressing a button.

invalid.autoAttachCurrency: Meta does not accept this currency.
invalid.baseCurrency: Use a three letter currency code.

step2.title: 2. Attach one customer by hand
step2.hintAuto: Automatic attach is on: new numbers of reseller workspaces are attached for you.
step2.hintManual: Pick a connected number and the currency it is billed in.
step2.attachAllBody: Your credit line is shared with every connected number of a reseller workspace that is not attached yet. Each is a call to Meta.
step2.attachAllMore: {remaining} more are waiting. Run it again.
step2.empty: No customer has connected a WhatsApp Business (Cloud API) number yet. It appears here once they do.
step2.locked: Locked once attached: Meta does not allow changing the currency later.

register.title: Credit lines in use
register.empty: No accounts attached yet. Finish steps 1 and 2 above.
register.revokeBody: Meta stops billing you for this number and the customer pays Meta directly again.
register.revokeStillReseller: This workspace is still on reseller billing: its wallet keeps being charged per message while Meta bills the customer directly.
register.label: Credit allocations

guide.title: Setup guide
guide.step1Body: Find it in Meta Business Settings under Business info.
guide.step2Body: Create a system user in your business and generate a token with these permissions. It is shown once.
guide.step3Body: You need an approved extended credit line. When the id is left blank it is read from Meta automatically.
guide.good1: The currency of a credit line is locked once attached.
guide.good2: Attaching means Meta bills you, but you still set your customers' prices.
guide.good3: You can revoke at any time and the customer pays Meta directly again.

dashboard.title: Reseller P&L
dashboard.intro: Revenue is what customers were charged for delivered messages, Meta cost is what the same messages cost you, margin is the difference. Refunded and free messages are not counted.
dashboard.walletFloatHint: Money in customer wallets, all workspaces
dashboard.unpricedBanner: {count, plural, one {# billed message has} other {# billed messages have}} no Meta cost for their country and category, so the margin counts them as pure revenue.
dashboard.empty: No billed messages this month yet.
dashboard.more: Only the top workspaces by revenue are listed.
dashboard.loadFailed: The P&L could not be loaded.

customer.title: How are messages billed?
customer.subtitle: Choose who bills you for WhatsApp messages sent through your connected numbers.

direct.title: I pay Meta directly
direct.body: Your own payment method is on Meta. You only need an active plan.

reseller.title: Bill me through the platform
reseller.body: Messages are charged per message from your wallet, and the platform's credit line is shared with your number.

customer.savedReseller: Billing set: messages are charged per message from your wallet.
customer.savedDirect: Billing set: Meta bills you directly.

customer.noNumbers: No WhatsApp Business (Cloud API) number is connected yet.
